2609.38420.title: What Was Said, Not What Was 'Thought': Type-6 Logic for CoT Verification
2609.38420.paper_summary: We introduce Type-6 logic, a variant of dynamic epistemic logic augmented with two operators (uncertainty and recurrence), designed to model the inferential dynamics of contemporary large language model (LLM) chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning. Type-6 accounts for common LLM reasoning pathologies such as unlicensed revision, enthymemes, loopbacks, and unverifiable/incorrect claims. We propose a verifier based on Type-6 logic that builds a graph out the trace, and checks it against Type-6's axioms and inference rules. We evaluate our framework on LLM-generated CoTs four splits spanning formal and informal reasoning. Our verifier detects structurally unsound reasoning steps that surface-level heuristics miss, and allows for easy visualisation of the model's reasoning process. In our corpus, our verifier shows that derived contradiction is the most common hard-fail category in CoT, and that only about 3\% of the propositions of a trace have impact on the final derivation. Ablation studies show that other verification methods (LLMs-as-judges, other neurosymbolic approaches, etc.) cannot be considered interchangeable: for example, agreement between LLMs-as-judges and LINC is $κ\approx 0.034$, and this persists within a method across underlying models. Type-6, however, is the most agreed-with method amongst the ones we tested. We prove our verifier runs on average-case linear time; and release our logic specification and artefacts.
2609.38420.paper_summary_zh: 我們介紹了 Type-6 邏輯，這是一種增強了兩個運算子的動態認識論邏輯變體（不確定性和重現性），旨在建模當代大型語言模型（LLM）思維鏈（CoT）推理的推理動態。Type-6 考慮了常見的 LLM 推理病理，如未經授權的修訂、隱含前提、回圈和無法驗證/不正確的主張。我們提出了一種基於 Type-6 邏輯的驗證器，該驗證器從追蹤中構建圖形，並根據 Type-6 的公理和推理規則進行檢查。我們在涵蓋正式和非正式推理的四個分割上評估了我們的框架，這些分割是 LLM 生成的 CoT。我們的驗證器檢測到結構上不穩健的推理步驟，這些步驟是表面啟發式所忽略的，並且允許輕鬆可視化模型的推理過程。在我們的語料庫中，我們的驗證器顯示衍生矛盾是 CoT 中最常見的硬失敗類別，並且大約只有 3\% 的追蹤命題對最終推導有影響。消融研究顯示，其他驗證方法（如 LLMs-as-judges、其他神經符號方法等）不能被視為可互換的：例如，LLMs-as-judges 和 LINC 之間的協議為 $κ\approx 0.034$，這在不同模型的同一方法中持續存在。然而，Type-6 是我們測試過的方法中最被一致認同的方法。我們證明了我們的驗證器在平均情況下運行於線性時間；並發布了我們的邏輯規範和工件。
